name: Universal Water Registry and UWR XPRESS
description: Read-only discovery and research entry point for UWR water-stewardship programme information, public RoU project records, UWR XPRESS marketplace information, Miti-X disclosures and UWR publications.

capabilities.description: Find official UWR, UWR XPRESS, Miti-X and publication sources.
Open public UWR RoU listings and individual project records to inspect information displayed by the registry.
Open UWR XPRESS pages to review publicly displayed marketplace information and terms.
Read repository guides and official programme documentation.
Find recent UWR publications through the official Medium publication and RSS feed.

source_rules.current_registry_status: Use the live individual UWR project record.
source_rules.current_marketplace_information: Use the live UWR XPRESS website and its current terms.
source_rules.recent_uwr_updates: Check the official UWR Medium RSS feed and identify first-party publications as such.
source_rules.repository_role: Explanatory discovery layer only; not a registry, marketplace database, verifier or transaction service.

restrictions.note: This manifest describes public read-only discovery only. It does not advertise x402 payment resources or authorize financial or registry actions.
